If the data string contains non alpha-numeric characters, spawn two threads underscores, spawn two threads. Using a sem_post before ever calling sem_wait causes the counting semaphore to allow two processes into the critical section instead of just one when the previous process unblocks. In order to hit the weakness, qsize >= 5000000, and the data string must have non-alphanumeric characters it.
